# twilio-ruby

**Tag**: web, security, tooling

## 简介

The official library for communicating with the Twilio REST API, building TwiML, and generating Twilio JWT Capability Tokens

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/twilio/twilio-ruby
- 文档: https://www.twilio.com/docs/libraries/reference/twilio-ruby/
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/twilio-ruby
